_how: Ground truth for the README measurement. Labelled from the RAW, un-annotated frames (no system boxes shown), with an AI assistant (Claude) drafting each label from frame sheets; every label is listed here with its time so it can be re-checked. A [low, high] pair means a person stands on the edge of the zone or is mostly hidden: the system is counted correct anywhere in the range.

shop1._rule: a crossing = the feet pass the glass door's threshold; IN = into the shop (moving left)

events.who: woman in white coat - crosses paths with the man leaving
man with glasses - crosses paths with the woman entering
girl in grey top carrying a white tray

not_a_crossing.who: older woman in beige coat walks onto the threshold and STOPS there until the clip ends (should not be counted)

shop1._rule: people whose feet are inside the queue polygon (config/measure.yaml), every 5 s

market._rule: customers whose feet are inside either lane polygon (both tills together), every 10 s over the whole 5 min; cashiers excluded

cafe._rule: customers in front of the counter (cashier excluded), every 25 s; ranges where people are hidden in the crowd

alerts._rule: queue alert: >= 3 people for >= 10 s; empty counter: nobody in the staff zone for >= 15 s while >= 1 person waits. Episode times from the frames (1-3 s steps around each edge).

shop1.note: queue of 3-7 from the start until ~82 s

market.note: man in yellow shorts joins lane 2 while two customers are at lane 1

_none_expected.shop1 empty_counter: a cashier is at the till the whole clip
_none_expected.market empty_counter: both cashiers leave at ~237 s; the only customer then (lane 1, ~240-265 s) has paid and is packing her bags - she is not waiting, so no alert is expected (borderline case, see README)
